name: E-commerce team
description: Online-shop operations: Muse (marketing), Spark (social), Milo (order chain), Forge (support and build); builds on the general pack: Echo (customer support), Ledger (finance), Scout (research).

send_customer_email.label: Send an email to a customer

upload_parcel_label.label: Upload a parcel label to the carrier (prepared, not printed)

edit_shopify_order.label: Edit a Shopify order (add the owner's house number, set a COD order paid after the GLS transfer)

ops.order_watch.name: Milo: order watch
ops.order_watch.task: Order watch, as in your agent file: for the open orders, is the invoice (or its draft) there and does the parcel label exist? Read and dry runs only (connectors/order_checks.py open, parcel_prepare without --send). Anything missing for more than 2 hours: one line per order number with what is missing. Never upload a label or issue an invoice from here.

ops.stock_alert.name: Milo: stock alert
ops.stock_alert.task: Stock alert, as in your agent file: the products that run out within 7 days at the last 28 days' sales speed. A list, not an order. Write it to handoffs/milo/<date>-stock.md; reply SILENT when nothing runs out.

marketing.weekly_plan.name: Muse: weekly plan
marketing.weekly_plan.task: The weekly plan, as in your agent file: 1 focus product group, 1 message, 3 channels, 1 metric, with the numbers it rests on. Write it to handoffs/marketing/<week>-plan.md. A budget is a suggestion in words, never an approval item.

social.weekly_calendar.name: Spark: weekly content calendar
social.weekly_calendar.task: The weekly content calendar from this week's marketing plan (handoffs/marketing/), as in your agent file: per post channel, time, copy, image brief, hashtags, goal. Write it to handoffs/social/<week>-calendar.md. It is a plan for the owner to look at: do not queue posts from this run.

marketing.weekly_measurement.name: Muse: weekly measurement
marketing.weekly_measurement.task: The weekly measurement, as in your agent file: visitors, carts, conversion, best and worst product from the connectors, and 3 sentences on what follows. Write it to handoffs/marketing/<week>-measurement.md for the Friday report.
